name: TypeScript
description: TypeScript is JavaScript with static types. It catches errors at compile time, enables fearless refactoring, and powers the largest codebases in the world. These are the definitive free resources — vetted, current, and complete.

items.title: TypeScript Handbook (Official)
items.description: The official handbook by Microsoft. Covers every feature from basic types to advanced inference, generics, and modules.

items.title: TypeScript Deep Dive
items.description: A comprehensive open-source book by Basarat Ali Syed covering real-world patterns, project setup, and migration strategies.

items.title: Type Challenges — Solutions Book
items.description: Companion guide to type-challenges with detailed explanations of over 100 advanced type puzzles.

items.title: TypeScript Official Docs
items.description: The complete official documentation: handbook, reference, tutorials, release notes, and TSConfig reference.

items.title: TypeScript Playground
items.description: Interactive sandbox with instant type evaluation, TSConfig toggles, and shareable code snippets.

items.title: TypeScript Wiki (GitHub)
items.description: Community-maintained wiki covering design decisions, breaking changes, and advanced topics.

items.title: Total TypeScript — Free Tutorials
items.description: High-quality interactive tutorials by Matt Pocock covering generics, patterns, and real-world TypeScript.

items.title: freeCodeCamp — TypeScript Course
items.description: A structured project-based course walking through type annotations, interfaces, generics, and building applications.

items.title: TypeScript — The Complete Course (freeCodeCamp)
items.description: Comprehensive multi-hour course covering everything from basic types to advanced patterns.

items.title: TypeScript for Beginners (Academind)
items.description: A beginner-friendly walkthrough of TypeScript essentials with practical code-along examples.

items.title: Type Challenges — TypeScript Type Puzzles
items.description: Over 200 community-sourced type-level challenges from easy to extreme. The gold standard for mastering advanced types.

items.title: Exercism — TypeScript Track
items.description: 100+ coding exercises with automated analysis and optional human mentoring.

items.title: Codewars — TypeScript Kata
items.description: Solve community-created challenges while getting typed feedback.

items.title: TypeScript Cheatsheets (Official)
items.description: Official one-page reference sheets for controls, interfaces, types, classes, and utility types.

items.title: TypeScript Utility Types
items.description: Complete reference for all built-in utility types: Partial, Pick, Omit, Record, ReturnType, and more.

items.title: TypeScript Blog (Official)
items.description: Official Microsoft blog with deep-dive release notes, roadmap posts, and feature previews.

items.title: TypeScript Weekly
items.description: A curated weekly newsletter covering TypeScript articles, type challenges, and open-source tools.

items.title: Reddit r/typescript
items.description: The largest TypeScript community on Reddit for discussions, articles, and ecosystem news.

items.title: TypeScript Discord (Official)
items.description: The official TypeScript Discord server for community Q&A.

items.title: TypeScript GitHub Discussions
items.description: Official GitHub discussions for feature requests, design proposals, and RFCs.

lessons.title: TypeScript Setup and Configuration
lessons.description: Install TypeScript, configure tsconfig.json, understand the compilation pipeline, and set up a development workflow.

lessons.title: Basic Types and Type Annotations
lessons.description: Primitive types, array types, tuple types, enum types, the any/unknown/never types, and type inference.

lessons.title: Functions and Function Types
lessons.description: Function type annotations, optional/default/rest parameters, overloads, this typing, and call signatures.

lessons.title: Object Types and Interfaces
lessons.description: Object type literals, interfaces, optional/readonly properties, index signatures, and interface extension.

lessons.title: Arrays, Tuples, and Enums
lessons.description: Array types, readonly arrays, tuple types with labels and spreads, const assertions, and enum best practices.

lessons.title: Union, Intersection, and Literal Types
lessons.description: Union types, intersection types, literal types, narrowing with typeof/in/instanceof, and discriminated unions.

lessons.title: Interfaces and Type Aliases Deep Dive
lessons.description: Interface merging, extending types, recursive types, mapped type modifiers, and conditional type constraints.

lessons.title: Generics: Basics and Constraints
lessons.description: Generic functions, generic constraints, generic interfaces, default types, and covariance/contravariance.

lessons.title: Keyof, Typeof, and Indexed Access Types
lessons.description: The keyof operator, typeof operator, indexed access types, and building type-safe lookup patterns.

lessons.title: Conditional and Mapped Types
lessons.description: Conditional types, infer keyword, distributive conditionals, mapped types, and template literal types.

lessons.title: Classes and Inheritance
lessons.description: Class type annotations, access modifiers, parameter properties, abstract classes, and implements clauses.

lessons.title: Modules and Declaration Files
lessons.description: ES modules, import/export syntax, ambient declarations, module augmentation, and writing .d.ts files.

lessons.title: Type Narrowing and Type Guards
lessons.description: User-defined type guards, assertion functions, the never type for exhaustiveness, and discriminated union patterns.

lessons.title: Utility Types and Satisfies
lessons.description: Built-in utility types (Partial, Required, Pick, Omit, Extract, Exclude, ReturnType), the satisfies operator, and Awaited.

lessons.title: Async/Await and Promise Typing
lessons.description: Typing async functions, Promise generics, async iterators, error handling patterns, and Promise.all/race/allSettled typing.

lessons.title: tsconfig.json Deep Dive
lessons.description: Compiler options explained: strict, moduleResolution, target, paths, type roots, project references, and build mode.

lessons.title: Advanced Type Patterns
lessons.description: Branded types, nominal typing patterns, type-safe builders, the `as const` pattern, and type-level programming.

lessons.title: React with TypeScript
lessons.description: Typing components, props, state, events, refs, hooks, context, and higher-order components with TypeScript.

lessons.title: Decorators and Mixins
lessons.description: Experimental decorators, legacy vs TC39 decorators, class/method/accessor/property decorators, and mixin patterns.

lessons.title: Performance and Compiler API
lessons.description: TypeScript performance optimization, incremental builds, const generics, the compiler API, and custom transformers.

lessons.title: Migration Patterns and Advanced Configuration
lessons.description: Migrating JS to TS gradually, allowJs, checkJs, strict mode adoption, path mapping, and monorepo patterns.
